own_stochastic_model.name: Student endpoint-duration bridge with relaxing correlated2Dvelocity
own_stochastic_model.styles: Four independent256wide3residual encoders, eightlatentstyles each, equalencoderprior; all32styles integrated.
own_stochastic_model.velocity_mean: m_1=mu_initial; m_i=mu_cruise+rho*(m_(i-1)-mu_cruise). Means andcovariances are predicted from publicq/style.
own_stochastic_model.velocity_covariance: Conditionally on global inverseGamma scale lambda, Cov(v_i,v_j)=lambda*rho^abs(i-j)*Sigma_xy. Sigma_xy positive definite2x2; lambda~IG(5/2,5/2).
own_stochastic_model.endpoint_mean: M_n=n*mu_cruise+H_n(rho)*(mu_initial-mu_cruise), H_n=sum_(i=0..n-1)rho^i. Use cumulativepowers rather than cancellation-prone division.
own_stochastic_model.endpoint_density: ExactbivariateStudent t5 density of endpoint(1,0), under thismodel.
own_stochastic_model.inference: p(n|publicq) proportional to sum_style pi_style* t5_2((1,0);M_n,S_n*Sigma_xy); normalize over same116durations, uniform nprior.
own_stochastic_model.fit_fullpath: MultivariateStudent t of dimension2n overincrements. Quadraticform uses first(v_1-mu_initial) and ARinnovations(v_i-mu_cruise-rho*(v_(i-1)-mu_cruise)) fori>=2.
own_stochastic_model.auxiliary: Conditionalinteriorpath logdensity is fullpath logdensity minusendpoint logdensity, withstyles integrated, divided by2*(n-1) forcomposite scoring.
